title: Go Bronco! Go Bearcats!
summary: University of Cincinnati's Dean of Engineering, and Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer witnessed Bronco engine demonstration.
body_markdown:
## Go Bronco! Go Bearcats!


We had a blast hosting John Weidner, Dean of Engineering at UC, and Ryan Hays, Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer at UC during a demonstration of our powerful Bronco engine! The University of Cincinnati’s aerospace division continues to support Ohio’s distinguished contributions in aerospace research and development.


Fun fact: our CEO and Senior Propulsion Engineer are both UC grads!


[University of Cincinnati College of Engineering & Applied Science](https://ceas.uc.edu/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gmb)
